reviews.title: cooling fan
reviews.comment: This is a great design (one stop solution). I'm using this to provide nominal cooling to a mini-rack of schitt audio components, two of which get warm. This works well, right now I just have the fan sitting on the top mesh bracket blowing downwards, I'm not sure if it will fit on the bottom and blow upwards, but thats not a failure point.  This items comes with the parts to make it work. It obviously is thicker than a regular case fan given its additional parts (which can be removed if desired. This would be a good choice to cool audio amps or other devices that get hot. Very quite and suitable for the job it does.
reviews.author: JoeAverage-User

reviews.title: Excellent solution for cooling audio equipment
reviews.comment: I set this unit up to cool a Schiit Audio stack and it keeps everything cool, cools the class A amp with ease and is quite. Very expensive fan kit, but you can tell it is fairly well thought out.
reviews.author: KC

reviews.title: Overkill but very nice
reviews.comment: Bought this for off label use on a reptile enclosure, works great and is quiet. Definitely overkill but at least I know it’s a reliable and quiet fan.
reviews.author: Allen G

reviews.title: JUST A FAN
reviews.comment: For starters I got a box of parts with no instructions.Comes with a multifunction controller but no instructions. The product description does not clearly say what actually comes in the box. I decided to reverse the air flow for my stereo and almost broke the casing trying to switch the safety grill to the other side of the fan.Claims flexible uses but no instructions. Lastly it interferes with AM radio reception
reviews.author: M. J. Reid
